application: Handheld Clinical Optical Biosensor for Cardiovascular Troponin, Sepsis, and Blood Biomarkers

process_steps.title: Substrate Surface Preparation (Optical Grade Fused Silica Wafer)
protocol: Piranha clean: H2SO4:H2O2 (3:1 volume ratio) at 120°C for 20 minutes to eliminate all particulate and organic residues.
Cascade deionized (DI) water rinse until bath resistivity reaches 18.2 MOhm-cm.
Surface activation via Oxygen Plasma (100 W, 20 sccm O2, 0.2 mbar for 3 minutes) to maximize surface hydrophilicity.
Dehydration hotplate bake at 180°C for 20 minutes under nitrogen purge.

process_steps.title: Adhesion Layer & Ultra-Thin Gold (Au) Plasmonic Film Deposition
process_steps.equipment: Angstrom Engineering EvoVac Ultra-High Vacuum (UHV) E-Beam Evaporator

process_steps.title: CVD Monolayer Graphene Wet Transfer (Gate-Tunable Sensing Layer)
process_steps.equipment: Graphene Transfer Wet Station & Critical Point Dryer

parameters.graphene_source: CVD Monolayer Graphene on Copper Foil (Grolltex)
parameters.support_polymer: PMMA 950k A4 (300 nm, baked at 150°C for 5 min)
parameters.pmma_removal: Warm acetone bath at 50°C for 30 minutes followed by IPA rinse
parameters.raman_verification: I_2D / I_G > 2.1, D-band defect peak undetectable

process_steps.title: High-Resolution Nanopatterning (Electron-Beam Lithography / DUV Stepper)
process_steps.equipment: Raith EBPG5200 100kV Electron Beam Lithography System

process_steps.title: Argon Ion Beam Milling (IBM) & ICP Dry Etch
process_steps.equipment: Oxford Instruments Ionfab 300 Plus Ion Beam Etcher

parameters.post_etch_clean: Oxygen plasma ash (300 W, 5 min) to remove cross-linked ZEP resist

process_steps.title: Self-Assembled Monolayer (SAM) & Bio-Receptor Functionalization
protocol: Thiolation: Submerge chip in 10 mM 11-Mercaptoundecanoic acid (11-MUA) in anhydrous ethanol for 18 hours in darkness to form a dense self-assembled monolayer (-COOH terminated).
Rinse thoroughly with ethanol and ultrapure DI water; dry under gentle N2 stream.
Carboxyl Activation: Treat with freshly prepared 0.4 M EDC (1-ethyl-3-(3-dimethylaminopropyl)carbodiimide) and 0.1 M NHS (N-hydroxysuccinimide) in 10 mM MES buffer (pH 5.5) for 25 minutes.
Antibody Conjugation: Incubate with Anti-Cardiac Troponin I (cTnI) monoclonal antibodies (50 ug/mL in PBS pH 7.4) for 2 hours at room temperature.
Surface Blocking: Quench unreacted NHS esters with 1.0 M Ethanolamine-HCl (pH 8.5) for 10 minutes followed by 1% Bovine Serum Albumin (BSA) in PBS to eliminate non-specific binding.

process_steps.title: Microfluidic Cartridge Integration (Capillary Blood/Serum Chamber)
process_steps.equipment: Karl Suss MicroTec PDMS Plasma Bonder & Capillary Fluidics Assembly

parameters.channel_material: Optical-grade Dow Sylgard 184 Silicone Elastomer (PDMS, 10:1 ratio)
parameters.channel_dimensions: Height = 50 um, Width = 200 um, Length = 12 mm
parameters.fluidic_flow_mode: Passive Capillary Flow (zero external pump required, volume = 5.0 uL whole blood)
parameters.surface_treatment: Oxygen Plasma 50 W for 30s to irreversibly bond PDMS to Metasurface Chip
parameters.integrated_filter: Sub-micrometer leukocyte/erythrocyte separation membrane at inlet port
